name: BBS Classic
direction: The most faithful app-scale expression of the canonical identity. Full electric-blue ground, entirely flat and uniform. One very large perfectly centered lime pixel u with its crisp cyan one-step lower edge and substantial hard near-black offset shadow, directly matching input image 1. Enlarge and balance the mark for a square app icon; retain enough blue padding for an outer rounded app mask. No extra border, sparkle, texture, hardware motif or ornament. Four colors only. Meticulously clean large pixels and exact front-facing geometry. This should feel iconic and inevitable.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: standalone square app-icon concept for usermods on iOS and macOS, exactly ONE icon, 1:1 canvas, target 1024 × 1024.
Input image 1 is the approved canonical app mark: a chunky lime pixel lowercase u, cyan lower edge, near-black hard shadow, electric-blue ground. Preserve that recognizable u silhouette and its square-grid geometry. Input image 2 is the approved BBS Underground brand reference, for the limited palette and hacker-playful personality only. Do not copy the banner composition, full wordmark, mascot, scenery or text.
Brand palette: electric blue #1008C8, lime #AEFF24, cyan #00E5F2, ink #030B16; magenta #F343D3 and yellow #FFF345 only for small supporting accents.
Design for app-icon scale: one bold central recognizable symbol, generous breathing room, simple clean silhouette, strong contrast. Keep the main symbol inside the central 72% of the canvas. Tiny details must not carry meaning. Consistent deliberate square-pixel construction, stepped corners and hard graphic edges in the mark. The result must still clearly read as the SAME usermods brand and the SAME primary u mark at 32px.
Production composition: full-bleed square artwork with an entirely opaque background extending to every edge and every corner. Do not bake rounded outside corners into the image; the icon's outer shape will be previewed separately. No transparent border, no floating app tile on a backdrop, no cast shadow OUTSIDE a tile, no device mockup, no surrounding desktop, no montage, no multiple options, no labels, no watermark. The image itself is the complete icon artwork.
No letters or written text except the single u-shaped logo. No Apple/system logos, no full brand name, no mascot head replacing the approved mark. Do not turn u into v, w, a power symbol or generic brackets.

Specific art direction:

Meticulously clean large pixels and exact front-facing geometry. This should feel iconic and inevitable.

name: Pixel Relief
direction: A premium tactile app-icon interpretation without losing BBS geometry. Full electric-blue background. The faithful lime pixel u from image 1 is centered and appears built from three thin, precisely aligned hard-edged layers: lime face, cyan intermediate layer visible mainly along its bottom and right edges, and ink-blue shallow backing layer. The shape is front-facing, not tilted or isometric, with the exact coarse stepped silhouette intact. Extremely restrained directional shading inside the layers gives subtle physical depth like precision-cut matte acrylic. No rounded glyph corners, no gloss or glass reflections, no perspective distortion, no extraneous objects. A native-app polish with all the character in the pixel silhouette.

name: Night Terminal
direction: A dark app-icon alternative. Full near-black ink background. A single centered chunky lime u with cyan lower lip and electric-blue stepped offset backing, as faithful as possible to input image 1. Four oversized cyan L-shaped pixel corner brackets loosely frame the u with generous gaps; they are simple 2-step ANSI terminal corners, not a continuous border. One tiny magenta square in the upper-right bracket gives playful BBS personality. Main lime u remains 65% of the overall width and carries all recognition. Flat colors, no gradient or glow, no fine dot pattern, no extra writing. Confident dark-mode look with vivid lime silhouette.

name: Browser Badge
direction: An icon that makes website modification legible while retaining the approved u. Full electric-blue background. A large minimal cyan-outlined browser-window glyph with chunky stepped corners, centered inside the canvas. Its dark ink content area contains the same huge lime u and cyan lower lip from image 1, filling nearly all the window's usable space. A very shallow title strip has only three simple square controls in magenta, yellow and lime. All shapes broad and chunky enough for a small Dock icon; no URL bar, browser text, content tiles, tiny linework, sparkle or cursor. A strong outer browser silhouette and unmistakable central u. Front-facing flat BBS pixel graphic.

name: Modular U
direction: A playful customization variant on the approved u mark. Full electric-blue ground. One large central lime pixel u, with cyan lower edge and hard ink shadow, built from a small number of broad square modules so it reads as a single solid silhouette at small size. At the upper-right stem, exactly ONE small square cap module has been lifted upward by one grid unit, exposing a tiny cyan joint; the lifted cap is magenta while the rest of the u remains lime. This one deliberate movable pixel expresses modding. Preserve the broad u shape, vertical stems, bottom bridge and generous counter from the canonical mark. No additional floating pieces, arrow, sparkles or border. Flat precise square pixels, no soft shadows or gradients.
